issues.description: NEVRA filename's first character may not be a valid Koji subdirectory letter
issues.detail: Koji's canonical path uses the lowercased first letter of the package NAME, not the first character of the full NEVRA filename. Since NEVRA filenames begin with the name anyway, this usually works, but packages whose names start with non-alphabetic characters (e.g. '389-ds-base') will produce a '3/' path which is correct for koji, while symbol-prefixed names would break. Worth documenting/validating.

issues.description: extract_arch_from_url returns None silently, producing a malformed URL
issues.detail: If no arch is matched, extract_arch_from_url returns None, and the f-string then builds '.../latest/None/Packages/...'. This silently emits a broken URL into rpms.lock.yaml instead of raising. Add an explicit error/raise when arch cannot be parsed so failures are loud, not silent.

issues.description: noarch packages will fail arch extraction and yield a bad URL
issues.detail: Per generate_main, repoquery includes '--arch noarch'. A noarch RPM URL (e.g. .../noarch/foo.noarch.rpm) won't match any of x86_64/aarch64/ppc64le/s390x, so extract_arch_from_url returns None and the constructed koji URL is invalid. Add 'noarch' to the arch list or handle the noarch case explicitly.

issues.description: Race condition between bump-lockfile merge and coreos-koji-tagger acknowledged but unmitigated
issues.detail: The PR description notes a race where the URL is written before coreos-koji-tagger actually tags the build into coreos-pool, which would make hermetic builds 404 transiently. Consider adding a verification step (HEAD request or retry) or at minimum log a clear warning so CI failures during the race are diagnosable.

issues.description: Substring check 'koji_url_base in url' is fragile
issues.detail: Using 'in' to detect a coreos-pool URL would also match any URL that happens to contain the kojipkgs path as a substring (unlikely in practice but brittle). Prefer url.startswith(koji_url_base) for an exact origin check.

issues.description: Arch list hardcoded and duplicated from elsewhere in the codebase
issues.detail: The arches list ['x86_64', 'aarch64', 'ppc64le', 's390x'] is hardcoded here while get_basearch and other parts of cosalib likely already enumerate supported arches. Centralize this list to avoid drift when a new arch is added.

review.summary: The PR replaces the previous DNF5 workaround with a URL-rewriting approach that maps all non-coreos-pool URLs into the canonical koji path. The approach is reasonable for the Konflux-only use case, but has a few sharp edges: noarch packages will trip extract_arch_from_url and yield a malformed URL, silent None returns produce broken URLs rather than loud failures, and the acknowledged race with coreos-koji-tagger has no mitigation. Minor robustness improvements around the substring origin check and centralizing the arch list would also help.
